title: Deterministic full-range GT BSGS accounting control

claims.statement: For the protected full-production fixed-G1 pairing-inversion problem, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md returns Q in G2 satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success probability 1, total work at most 2^145 dense-Fp12 equivalents at C=20,000, peak memory at most 2^141 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^144 equivalents included in total work, and no nonuniform advice. This analytic classical accounting control requires exponential memory and makes no practical execution or novelty claim.
